title: Make the CAFE sign glow like neon
where: front (north) dark panel x11..15, y3..4, z4; underline at x12..14,y2,z4
instruction: The orange banner letters are flat. Put two glowing wall signs, B.sign("spruce",["","CAFE","",""],{facing:"north",color:"orange",glow:true}), at x13,y2,z3 and x12,y2,z3 (north-facing, on the panel; the hedge is at x14..15), keep the shroomlight underline at y2, re-render the sign closeup.

title: Hanging blade sign at the entrance
where: in front of door x8..9, y3, z3
instruction: signboard hanging on the north face above the door: mcd paint rule `north row 3 cols 6-7 -> signboard "CAFE" hanging spruce` (or signboard() from code) so a blade sign reads down the street.

title: Interior counter detail
where: counter x5..12 (u4..11), y1..2, z9; back bar z10
instruction: Add stools at x6,8,10,12,y1,z8 (spruce_fence with a spruce_slab top on y2 is not needed: use spruce_stairs facing north), candles on the counter top (y3) only where a block is below, and swap 2 bookshelf cells at z10,y2 for barrels.

title: Add a mullion rhythm to the glass
where: front glass x4..9,y1..4,z4 and side glass x3,y1..4,z5..10
instruction: mcd paint rule `north openings -> mullions black_concrete every 3` (and `east`/`west` for the side) so the glazing reads as panes in a slim dark frame with a mid transom; check closeup that it stays slim.

title: Terrace planters at the corners
where: plinth corners x0,z0 and x16,z0 and beside the steps x10..11,z1
instruction: planter(g,{at,face:"north",kind:"ground",width:2,depth:1}) at three more spots; swap moss soil for dirt if palette flags it. Leave the steps (x7..10,z0) clear.

title: Terrace string lights / more table lanterns
where: soffit over the front terrace z2..3 and west terrace x0..2
instruction: fixture(g,{at:[x,5,z],face:'north',mount:'hang'}) under the soffit every 3 blocks over the terrace so the terrace has light (no lantern at x0..2 yet).

title: Back wall relief
instruction: mcd paint: `south -> pilasters every 5 profile simple deepslate_tiles` and `south x 10..13 y 2..3 -> louvres oak_trapdoor`; skip the door at x5 and the window x7..9.

title: West wall detail
instruction: Two slit windows exist at z6..7 and z9; add `surround plain` on them, and `west -> weather light` on the deepslate bricks.

title: Roof fascia relief
instruction: mcd roof spec change: eave:'cornice' dentils false on the modern preset, or add a rooftop rail (rail:true) set back; a thin lighter coping line (smooth_stone slab) at y6 around the edge to catch the light.

title: Fix: dark-on-dark palette flag
where: walls x11..15 / back / west (deepslate_bricks) vs fascia deepslate_tiles
instruction: mcd palette flags trim-invisible. Change the wall block from deepslate_bricks to tuff_bricks or polished_deepslate in build.mjs (P.panel) and re-run; compare closeups.
